head: One UI 9.5 leaked feature: Memory app may save screenshots and notes
dek: Samsung appears to be preparing Memory, a Galaxy AI app for One UI 9.5 that collects your screenshots, voice notes, links and text in one searchable place, according to onboarding screens SamMobile found. Samsung hasn't confirmed it.
details: The leaked screens show AI-written titles, summaries and tags for each item, collections that group related items, and link detection in screenshots. You'd add things through the share sheet, by pasting or by recording a voice note, and you could rename, delete or favourite them. An on-device processing option is reportedly there, and the app can be turned off. Engadget compares it to Google's Pixel Screenshots.
where: Galaxy phones with One UI 9.5; not confirmed, expected with the Galaxy S27 in early 2027
means: If you keep screenshots and voice memos to remember things, a later Galaxy update may sort and search them for you.
todo: Nothing to do yet. A One UI 9.5 beta is expected soon, which may show whether Memory is in it.
